slices.title: Vite vanilla JS scaffold + CSP + Pages workflow
slices.dispatchText:
SLICE GRAFIK-01-SCAFFOLD

Project grafik_to, root G:\_Grafik_TO (git, branch main, NO remote yet, no push).
Spec (authoritative, Russian): G:\_Grafik_TO\docs\spec\TZ.md. Read sections 2, 3 and 7 only for this slice.
Delegate implementation to a cheap L3 worker; you review its diff and run the checks yourself.

Goal: static Vite + vanilla JS (ES modules) scaffold for GitHub Pages, browser-only.
1. REMOVE the wrong placeholder stack: CMakeLists.txt, src/main.cpp, resources/resources.qrc, empty include/.
2. package.json (private, type=module), deps: xlsx (SheetJS, install from the official CDN tarball
   https://cdn.sheetjs.com/ as SheetJS docs recommend; check current docs via Context7), exceljs.
   devDeps: vite, vitest, eslint (flat config eslint.config.js), prettier.
   scripts: dev, build, preview, test (vitest run), lint, verify = lint && test && build.
3. vite.config.js: base './' (works under any GitHub Pages repo name), build to dist/.
4. index.html (lang=ru): header, settings panel placeholder, drop zone placeholder, 4 tab placeholders
   (График ТО, Детализация, Исключенные записи, Сводка по месяцам), status line.
   Privacy guard: <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy"> with default-src 'self';
   connect-src 'self' https://isdayoff.ru; no external scripts/fonts/analytics.
5. src/styles/tokens.css (colors, spacing, radius, font stack, focus ring) + src/styles/main.css (compact layout).
6. src/main.js entry; src/modules/{parser,calendarService,scheduler,exporter,ui}.js stubs with one named
   export each; public/calendar/ (empty .gitkeep, fallback JSON comes in a later slice).
7. tests/smoke.test.js: imports every module stub; one test asserting index.html contains the CSP meta.
8. .github/workflows/deploy.yml: on push to main -> npm ci, npm run verify, actions/upload-pages-artifact (dist),
   actions/deploy-pages. Use current official Pages actions (check docs).
9. .gitignore (node_modules, dist, coverage), README.md (RU: purpose, privacy note, dev/build/test, deploy).
10. Rewrite docs/context/INDEX.md for the web stack (keep the resume marker line).

Verify (verify=off; L0 re-runs this exact command):
  npm ci --prefix G:\_Grafik_TO && npm --prefix G:\_Grafik_TO run verify
Report to architect :22601: STATUS done|failed, commit, changed files, verify result. EN <=10 lines. No push.
verifyCommands: npm ci --prefix G:\_Grafik_TO && npm --prefix G:\_Grafik_TO run verify
